summary.intent: Add a concurrency group to the simple release workflow template generated by the CLI init command, and open a PR for it with the spec, changeset and snapshot updated.
summary.outcome: The template, its pinned snapshot, and the CLI-WF-03 criterion in docs/specs/cli.json were updated. After an init test failure the generated workflow was trimmed to stay within 40 lines, CI was rerun, and the PR was committed and opened. The transcript shows no final CI result.

repo: The simple release workflow is a template at crates/callisto-graph/src/templates/simple_workflow.tmpl, and its rendered bytes are pinned by an insta snapshot in the init command tests.
Workflow criteria are tracked in docs/specs/cli.json (e.g. CLI-WF-03), and changing workflow behavior means updating the matching criterion.
The generated workflow has a 40-line limit enforced by an init test, so added YAML such as a concurrency block has to fit within that budget.
PRs in this repo need a changeset, and CI is run locally for the workflow PR before opening it.
Regenerating the snapshot can alter its header, which had to be restored manually afterward.

code.finding: Concurrency group added here; the rendered output must stay within 40 lines.
Pinned snapshot of the rendered workflow; it must be refreshed after template changes and its header checked.
CLI-WF-03 was updated to reflect the concurrency behavior.

workflow: Using a separate worktree isolates the workflow change from other in-flight work.
Run CI after each fix, since the first run exposed an init test failure that was only visible in the test output.
Snapshot refresh tooling can overwrite hand-maintained headers, so diff the snapshot after regenerating.

friction: The first CI run failed on an init test because the generated workflow exceeded 40 lines after the concurrency group was added.
Refreshing the snapshot clobbered its header, which had to be restored by hand.
CLI-WF-03 had to be read in full before it could be edited, which took extra steps.
open_items: Confirm the second CI run passes on the opened PR, as the transcript does not show the result.
Consider whether the 40-line limit will keep constraining future additions to the simple workflow template.
